keycloakUserName.description: The full name of the user (described in OIDC 1.0 'name' standard claim) as of the most recent logged-in service activity or Keycloak user sync.

syncedFromKeycloakAt.description: The last time this row was confirmed against Keycloak by a sync; null until the first sync.

disabledAt.description: The time this user was observed as absent from or not enabled in Keycloak by a sync; null if the user is still live in Keycloak. The user row is kept for referential integrity.
